body:
Taking over or launching a step from your computer now updates the step's runner on the board to whichever runner actually took it, so a step planned for Claude Code web no longer stays stuck under Claude Code web after another runner takes over. Antigravity launches and takeovers now work natively through the same launch command without trying to start Claude Code in the background.

### Why R5 stayed assigned to Claude Code web
Previously, `launch()` in `scripts/kit.py` never updated the `runner` field on the post or its `_trains` row, and its non-web path hard-coded `claude --bg` (refusing or falling back instead of supporting `agy`). As a result, taking over a step planned for `claude-web` on an `agy` machine either bypassed `kit.py launch --take` or left `runner: "claude-web"` stale on the board.

### What changed in `scripts/kit.py` (and `.kit/kit.py`)
- **Runner attribution on every launch and takeover:** `launch()` resolves the target launch mode from `PLATFORM_RULES["launcher"]` (plus explicit `--web`, `--cli-run`, or `--cli agy|claude`) and writes `runner` (`claude-web`, `agy`, or `claude-cli`) into the post fields, the `_trains` row (`_trains_mark`), the returned JSON payload, attached-board updates (`_launch_in_clone`), and `launch_text()`.
- **Native `agy` launch and takeover (`--cli agy` or running inside `agy`):**
  - Added `--cli {agy,claude}` to the `launch` CLI parser and forwarded it through `_launch_in_clone`.
  - When the resolved mode is `invoke_subagent`, `launch()` requires `agy` on `PATH` (loud `NOT STARTED` refusal otherwise, never silently invoking `claude --bg`), checks device capacity via `_device().gate(...)` when `PLATFORM_RULES["device_cap_gate"]` is true, prepares or adopts the step branch via `_prepare_agy_branch()` (preserving existing commits on local or `origin/<branch>` without switching the orchestrator's working tree or locking `.claude/worktrees/<branch>`), records `runner: "agy"` and `session_id: "pending: invoke_subagent (<name>)"`, and prints the exact `invoke_subagent(...)` call.
  - On `--take` (or `--session-id`), `launch()` preserves an existing `post["branch"]` instead of overwriting it with `_slug(part, 24)`.
  - `launch()` now gates `_alive_sessions()` on `_rule("alive_check", pl) == "claude_agents"`, so `agy` launches never invoke `claude agents --json`.

### Tests and `PLATFORM_RULES` pin
- **`tests/test_launch_runtime.py`:** added tests covering `claude-web` -> `agy` takeover (preserving branch commits, updating post + `_trains` runner, printing `invoke_subagent`, never invoking `claude --bg`), `--cli agy` device-cap gating and fresh branch creation, `claude-web` -> `claude-cli` takeover, `--web` keeping/updating `runner: "claude-web"`, and CLI `--cli agy --take` remote branch adoption (`origin/cl99`).
- **`tests/test_platform_matrix.py`:** pinned the complete literal `EXPECTED_PLATFORM_RULES` dict with `assertEqual(self.kit.PLATFORM_RULES, EXPECTED_PLATFORM_RULES)` (per `CR-r5-every-rule-that-differs-by-platform-says-2`), updated `test_launch_matches_table_on_every_platform` to run `agy` with `agy` (and a trap `claude`) on `PATH`, and added `test_agy_launch_without_agy_on_path_refuses_loudly`.

check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_platform_matrix tests.test_launch_runtime tests.test_launch tests.test_kit_copies_current -v
handoff: Any orchestrator (agy, Claude CLI, or Claude web) can now use `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post> [--take] [--cli agy|claude]` uniformly: `runner` is always rewritten to the actual launcher (`agy`, `claude-cli`, or `claude-web`) on the post and Trains row, and agy launches check device capacity, prepare or adopt the step branch (including `origin/<branch>`), and print the exact `invoke_subagent(...)` call. Any future edit to `PLATFORM_RULES` must also update the pinned `EXPECTED_PLATFORM_RULES` dict in `tests/test_platform_matrix.py`.

task:
When a step is launched or taken over on a computer (CLI or agy), kit.py launch must update the post runner field to the actual runner taking it (agy, claude-cli, or claude-web) and support agy launches/takeovers without hard-coding claude --bg.

1. In scripts/kit.py (`launch`), update `runner` in the post fields on every launch and `--take` (`claude-web`, `agy`, or `claude-cli`) so a step planned for one runner never stays stale after another runner takes it over.
2. When running on agy (or with `--cli agy`), `launch` in scripts/kit.py checks device capacity, prepares or adopts the step branch, records the takeover cleanly (`runner: "agy"`), and prints the exact `invoke_subagent` call instead of spawning `claude --bg`.
3. Tests in `tests/test_launch_runtime.py`: takeover updates `runner` from `claude-web` to `agy` and `claude-cli`; agy launch/takeover never invokes `claude --bg`; `--web` launch keeps `runner: "claude-web"`.
title: kit.py launch updates runner on takeover and supports agy launches
verdict: Launching or taking over any step now updates its runner to the actual launcher taking it, and Antigravity launches prepare or adopt the branch and print the subagent launch call instead of running Claude in the background.
